description: Strict JOSE vectors (spec §5.2). Protected header: exactly alg=EdDSA, typ=<expected>, optional kid (string, = RFC 7638 thumbprint of the verifying key); any other member (crit, b64, jku, ...) MUST be rejected. Claims: required NumericDates are JSON integers, required identifiers non-empty strings, exp >= iat. Verify at 'now' with the context given. Accept every valid entry; reject every negative entry.

negative.name: proof/typ_wrong
negative.must_reject_because: explicit typing: typ must be lmbp-proof+jwt

negative.name: proof/unknown_header
negative.must_reject_because: unknown protected header members are forbidden

negative.name: proof/kid_mismatch
negative.must_reject_because: kid must be the verifying key's thumbprint

negative.name: proof/iat_string
negative.must_reject_because: iat must be a JSON integer

negative.name: proof/wrong_key
negative.must_reject_because: signed by a key other than the verifying key
